masks-ritual.title: Tamata. Votive offering. Stylised representation of a standing child, hand modelled in olive green wax. Its right hand rests on its left hip and its left hand is placed on its abdomen. A loop of string protrudes from the top of its head suggesting a point of suspension. The eyes are black-eyed beans pushed into the wax. The right forearm is damaged, wax has cracked and fallen away.

Tamata. Votive offering. Representation of a young child in brown wax. A loop of string protrudes from the top of its head, suggesting a point of suspension. The head has a large indentation on its left side, possibly representing a deformity. There is a patch of white powder on the back of the head on its right side.

Tamata. Votive offering. Representation of a baby modelled in yellow wax. The eyes are represented by black-eyed beans pushed into the wax. A loop of string protrudes from the top of its head, suggesting a point of suspension. The wax in the neck area is badly cracked and bits have crumbled away.

Tamata. Votive offering. Stylised representation of a face and neck, modelled in wax. Reverse flat. It is mainly olive green in colour with some patches of black, the eyes are represented by black-eyed beans. A loop of string protrudes from the top of its head, suggesting a point of suspension.

Tamata. Votive offering. Stylised representation of a head and neck, hand modelled in yellow/green wax with eyes represented by black-eyed beans. The nose and mouth are stylised and the ears are represented by holes either side of the head. A loop of string protrudes from the top of its head, suggesting a point of suspension.

Tamata. Votive offering. Stylised representation of head and neck, hand modelled in green wax. The hair is shoulder length and there is a pink patch of colour at the back of the head. The eyes appear to have been gauged out. A loop of string protrudes from the top of its head, suggesting a point of suspension.

Tamata. Votive offering. Representation of a head and neck, modelled in pale green wax, black-eyed beans represent the eyes. The hair is shoulder length with a patch of pink colour at the back of the head. A loop of string protrudes from the top of its head, suggesting a point of suspension.

Tamata. Votive offering of an arm, modelled in green wax. The hand is represented by a square slab of wax with lines showing the divisions between the fingers, the thumb is separate. The arm is slightly bent at the elbow and a loop of string threaded through a hole in the upper arm suggests a point of suspension.

Tamata. Votive offering. Elongated and stylised leg modelled in green wax. The foot is represented by a square slab of wax with scratched on lines to show the divisions between the toes. The leg is slightly bent at the knee and a loop of string threaded through a hole above the knee suggests a point of suspension. Broken above knee.
Tamata. Votive offering. Representation of a heart, modelled in green wax. A string loop protrudes from the wide end suggesting a point of suspension.

Tamata. Votive offering of a kidney, hand modelled in green wax. It is an oval object with a shallow groove in the centre of one of the longer sides. There is a loop of string protruding from one of the shorter sides.

Tamata. Votive offering. Large nose made from green wax. Hand modelled cone shape with two indentations on the wider end to represent nostrils. A string loop on the narrower end suggests a point of suspension.

Tamata. Votive offering. Stylised representation of an eye, hand modelled in green wax to form a flat, oval shape. A black-eyed bean has been pushed into the centre of one side and is surrounded by several radiating grooves. There is a large loop of string attached to the top suggesting a point of suspension.
Tamata. Votive offering of an eye cut out of sheet silver. Depiction of eye has been engraved on one side. There is a semicircular tab and hole at the top for the attachment of a pin.
Tamata. Votive offering of a baby's face and neck made from cast and sheet silver, soldered together. Hole at the top of head for the attachment of a safety pin.
Silver plastic protective disc-shaped charm placed on car dashboard. Representation of St. Christopher on obverse. Simulated leather on reverse.
Gold plastic disc-shaped protective charm placed on car dashboard. Obverse side has colour print of the Madonna and Child flanked by angels. Simulated wood on reverse.

Hanging religious charm with colour printed pictures on both sides; Madonna & Child and St. Christopher. Each picture is surrounded by a row of sequins secured by small beads and metal pins. The edge of the central disc has radiating, cylindrical beads tipped with small, round beads and sequins. At the top and bottom of the central disc are rosettes of circular, flat beads and there are large, round beads on the outer edges. Attached to the top is a gold coloured metal chain for suspension. A gold coloured, plastic cross hangs from the bottom, flanked by two translucent plastic strawberries.

Keyring of protective charms. Large blue glass disc decorated with concentric white, yellow and blue glass rings intended to ward off the evil eye (nazar). Blue plastic bead below from which is suspended a golden horse-shoe painted with blue dots. From the centre of the horse shoe hangs a bunch of blue plastic grapes. Glass chipped upper right.

Hanging religious charm, highly decorated with plastic, multi-coloured (predominately green and yellow) beads and sequins. Central metal disc with colour printed pictures on both sides. The Madonna & Child and St. Nicholas. Each picture is surrounded by a row of sequins secured by small beads and metal pins. The edge of the central disc has radiating, cylindrical beads tipped with small, round beads and sequins. At the top and bottom of the central disc are rosettes of circular, flat beads and there are large, round beads on the outer edges. Attached to the top is a gold coloured, metal chain, providing a means of suspension. A gold coloured, plastic cross hangs from the bottom, flanked by two translucent strawberries.

textile.title: Tamata. Votive offering. Representation of an arm, stamped on thin, silver sheet to produce a slightly raised design. Incised detail around outline. The arm is bent at a right-angle. There is a semicircular tab and hole on the upper part of the arm for the attachment of a pin.

Tamata. Votive offering. A heart shape, stamped on thin, silver sheet to produce a slightly raised design. Incised detail around outline. There is a semicircular tab and hole at the top for the attachment of a pin.

Tamata. Votive offering. A representation of a child standing in profile with head turned to front, stamped on thin, silver sheet with incised detail. There is a semicircular tab and hole at the top of her head for the attachment of a pin.

Tamata. Votive offering. Stylistic representation of an ear, stamped on thin, silver sheeting to produce a slightly raised design. The ear has an elongated shape and a spiral design in the centre. Detail incised around the outline. There is a semicircular tab and hole at the top for the attachment of a pin.
Tamata. Votive offering of a kidney, stamped on thin, silver sheet metal. Detail incised around the outline. There is a semicircular tab and hole for attachment of a pin.

sculpture.title: Tamata. Votive offering. Rectangular piece of sheet silver metal with chased depiction of a male bust wearing a suit. Hole at top centre, for the attachment of a pin.
